preconditions.description: The number of arguments in the logical expression is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: a_i in {0, 1} for i in range(n)
preconditions.description: Each argument in the expression is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO' indicating whether it is possible to place brackets to make the expression false.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> (length of second line <= 10^6 and correct expression)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the second line contains a correct expression with brackets that evaluates to false.

invariants.expression: n is the number of arguments in the logical expression
invariants.description: The number of arguments in the logical expression is n.

invariants.expression: a_i are the values of the arguments in the expression
invariants.description: The values of the arguments in the expression are a_1, a_2, ..., a_n.
